<!-- Generated by internal/tools/docgen from the cobra command tree. DO NOT EDIT: run `make docs-reference`. -->

Shows organization-wide ingestion, search, and export usage over a time period.

For per-dataset usage, run: bronto api GET /usage/organizations/logs

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/api-reference/usage/overview](https://docs.bronto.io/api-reference/usage/overview)
:::

```sh
bronto usage [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--since` |  | string | `7d` | relative lookback (single unit: 1h, 7d) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto usage --since 7d
bronto usage --since 1h
```
